name: Heritage Mining Ltd.
summary: Heritage Mining Ltd. undertakes the sourcing, purchasing, appraisal, and development of mineral properties across Ontario, Canada, with a particular emphasis on gold and other precious metals. The company's portfolio includes a stake in the Drayton - Black Lake project, an extensive area within Ontario's Patricia Mining District spanning approximately 14,921.18 hectares over 720 mining claims. Furthermore, it maintains an interest in the Contact Bay property, an additional Ontario site comprising around 4,700 hectares and 147 mining claims. This company, established in 2019, operates from its Vancouver, Canada, headquarters.
